name: Dify
description: LLM app platform combining visual workflows, a RAG pipeline and autonomous agents, self-hosted with Docker Compose.
whatItDoes: Lets teams build and operate chat apps, RAG pipelines and agents through a visual interface, with model management and observability. It is for developers moving LLM applications from prototype to production.
howItWorks: A web console and API server orchestrate workflows, knowledge retrieval and agents that can use tools and a sandbox. Models and tools are added through the console. The licence is Apache 2.0 with extra conditions that restrict multi-tenant hosting and logo removal.

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: Docker and Docker Compose; at least 2 CPU cores and 4 GiB RAM

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: Model credentials configured in the console

models: Most hosted and self-hosted LLM providers
